title: Winter Fest 2026 Debuts New Winter-Themed Tournament Experience
snippet: More than 70 teams competed across 16 brackets at Central Park as Playmaker Sports introduced Winter Fest-themed trophies, medals, pins, backdrops, and an expanded tournament app experience.
author: Playmaker Sports
body: Playmaker Sports proudly hosted its second Winter Fest at Central Park, welcoming over 70 teams for a full weekend of competitive youth soccer and community engagement. Teams from across the region gathered in Santa Clarita to compete in a tournament that showcased competitive matches as well as the growth and professionalism of Playmaker Sports events.

Throughout the weekend, teams competed across 16 competitive brackets, ultimately crowning 16 champions and 16 finalists after an exciting slate of matches. In total, over 100 games were played across the park’s fields, providing players with meaningful competition and memorable tournament moments.

A major highlight of Winter Fest 2026 was the introduction of a brand-new themed awards set, something Playmaker Sports had never done before. For the first time, the tournament featured Winter Fest themed pins, medals, and trophies all designed in blue winter-inspired colors. The special edition design gave the tournament its own unique identity and added excitement for players competing for the awards.

Every participant in the tournament received a Playmaker Sports Winter Fest pin as a commemorative item for taking part in the event. Finalists and champions were awarded custom Winter Fest themed medals, while each championship team also received a team trophy designed specifically for the Winter Fest tournament. The winter theme was carried throughout the awards presentation and post-game celebrations.

The Winter Fest look extended beyond the awards themselves. For the first time, Playmaker Sports also introduced custom Winter Fest themed backdrops and championship/finalist photo signs using the same blue color palette. Teams celebrated their victories in front of these backdrops, creating memorable photo opportunities for players, coaches, and families.

Across the venue, Playmaker Sports continued to invest in creating a professional tournament atmosphere. CORA boards and Playmaker Sports flags were placed around the fields, helping build a strong visual presence throughout the park and enhancing the tournament environment as teams walked between games and warm-ups.

Player safety remained a priority throughout the event as always. Certified athletic trainers were stationed on site during the entire tournament, providing medical support for players when needed. The athletic trainers were equipped with medical tables, ice, and full first aid kits, allowing them to quickly assist athletes and respond to any injuries. Their presence ensured players had access to proper care while competing.

In addition to the athletic trainers, information tents were set up near the fields, staffed by Playmaker Sports personnel who assisted teams and families with directions, questions, and tournament logistics. These tents helped keep communication clear and made it easier for participants to navigate the large tournament venue.

Winter Fest 2026 also featured an updated version of the Playmaker Sports Tournament App, which helped teams stay informed throughout the weekend. The app allowed participants to easily view live schedules, standings, brackets, and field maps, and it also provided real-time notifications for field changes or schedule updates. The improvements made it easier for coaches, players, and parents to stay connected with tournament information as games progressed. Another new feature allowed participants to take photos and share them in a public gallery on the event page.

Referees played a crucial role in the success of the event, managing the fast-paced schedule of more than 100 matches across the weekend. Playmaker Sports recognized the importance of their contribution by presenting each referee with a special edition blue and silver Playmaker Sports coin, designed as a commemorative item for the Winter Fest tournament.

The tournament experience extended beyond the field as well. Families and players were able to enjoy food and refreshments throughout the weekend thanks to on-site vendors. Tiki Ice served refreshing shaved ice desserts and drinks, which quickly became a favorite treat for players between matches. In addition, Deli Doctor food truck was on site providing a variety of food options from sandwiches, burgers, specialty fries and drinks for players, families, and spectators throughout the tournament weekend.

Winter Fest 2026 brought together a strong community of teams, coaches, referees, families, and staff who helped make the event a success. Playmaker Sports extends its appreciation to all participating teams, families, referees, athletic trainers, and staff members for contributing to such a memorable weekend of soccer.

As Playmaker Sports continues to grow its tournament series, events like Winter Fest showcase the organization’s commitment to providing competitive opportunities, professional event management, and a memorable experience for young athletes.
Playmaker Sports looks forward to welcoming teams back for the Summer Championship on August 1 & 2, 2026 in Moorpark and continuing to build events that bring the soccer community together.

title: Playmakers Cup Delivers a Milestone Weekend in Moorpark With New Innovations
snippet: The third annual Playmakers Cup welcomed 96 teams for more than 150 matches and marked the official launch of the Playmaker Sports Tournament App, including Follow My Team and Follow My Club.
author: Playmaker Sports
body: Moorpark, CA — Playmaker Sports successfully hosted its third annual Playmakers Cup this past weekend at Arroyo Vista Park. The tournament welcomed 96 teams, held over 150 matches, and had thousands of players, coaches, and families in attendance for one of its most successful tournaments to date. The event showcased 19 competitive brackets, each crowning a champion and finalist. Champions received custom team trophies and medals, finalists earned medals, and all participants received a commemorative Playmaker Sports participation pin.

This year’s Playmakers Cup marked a major milestone with the official launch of the Playmaker Sports Tournament App, giving teams access to live schedules, standings, brackets, field maps, and real-time event updates. The app introduced two exclusive features—“Follow My Team” and “Follow My Club”—allowing families to track their team or club throughout the weekend and receive instant notifications. The platform significantly enhanced communication and the overall tournament experience and will now be a standard element of all future Playmaker Sports events.

Tournament operations were supported by certified athletic trainers stationed at all three information tents and a dedicated Playmaker Sports staff managing logistics across 14 fields. The tournament also benefited from the commitment and professionalism of multiple referee crews who worked matches across the weekend. Each official was recognized with a custom Playmaker Sports referee coin as a token of appreciation.

Championship Sunday featured a special guest appearance by Martín “El Pulpo” Zúñiga, former Chivas de Guadalajara and Mexico National Team goalkeeper. Zúñiga spent time engaging with participants—taking photos, signing autographs, handing out trophies, and offering encouraging words to upcoming players and teams. His graciousness and professionalism created unforgettable moments for everyone in attendance.

A professional photographer was also on-site throughout the event, capturing high-quality photos and videos of players, teams, and championship moments. All captured content will be shared on Playmaker Sports’ social media pages, and participants are encouraged to follow along to see the full highlights.

The atmosphere was elevated by a vibrant mix of vendors and food options. In the Kitchen served a wide variety of items including burgers, hot dogs, funnel cakes, chili fries, breakfast burritos, breakfast sandwiches, pizza, coffee, shaved ice, popcorn, cupcakes, and pastries. Soccer City provided custom apparel, including exclusive Playmaker Sports merchandise, while additional vendors offered jerseys, souvenirs, grip socks, and specialty soccer goods. Music played across the venue, bringing energy and excitement to the environment for players and families.

Playmaker Sports continued its commitment to elevating the event experience with expanded field décor, including new flags, CORA boards, and additional venue signage showcasing Playmaker branding throughout Arroyo Vista Park. Amenities were also improved with additional serviced restrooms and enhanced event layout. More visual elements, decorations, and player-focused features are already planned for the next tournament.
The organization now turns its attention to its next major event, Winter Fest, taking place February 28 – March 1, 2026 at Central Park in Santa Clarita.

title: Playmaker Sports Summer Championship Heats Up Moorpark
snippet: Over 90 teams from across Southern California gathered at Arroyo Vista Park in Moorpark for the Playmaker Sports Summer Championship. Two-time MLS Cup Champion Bryan Jordan joined to hand out medals and sign autographs.
author: Playmaker Sports
body: The Playmaker Sports Summer Championship brought the heat — both on and off the field — as over 90 teams from across Southern California gathered at Arroyo Vista Park in Moorpark for an unforgettable weekend of soccer. Competitive teams came together to compete in 19 divisions, playing more than 150 games across two days. The park was alive with the sights and sounds of competition — cheers from the sidelines, the whistle of referees, the smell of sizzling burgers and hot dogs drifting through the air, and the buzz of excited players getting ready to take the field.

Families and fans enjoyed a lively tournament atmosphere that went far beyond the games themselves. Smiley Hot Dogs served up grilled favorites, Tiki Ice offered refreshing shaved ice to help beat the summer heat, and other local food trucks provided everything from burgers and burritos to fries, and drinks. We also had plenty of soccer gear, including grip socks and custom Playmaker Sports apparel from Soccer City. Picture Pro Photography was there to capture professional team shots, ensuring that families left with lasting memories. The unveiling of the new Playmaker Sports Summer Championship trophy, our new custom backdrop for pictures, along with our signature medals made the winners’ celebrations even more special.

Championship Sunday delivered an extra thrill when two-time MLS Cup Champion Bryan Jordan, formerly of the LA Galaxy, joined us to hand out medals, sign autographs, take photos, and share words of encouragement with the players. His presence inspired many young athletes, giving them a glimpse of what it takes to play at the highest level.

Behind the scenes, it took a full team effort to bring the weekend to life. The dedicated referee crews worked tirelessly to keep the matches running smoothly, while the Playmaker Sports staff ensured every detail — from field setup to scheduling — was handled with care. The City of Moorpark and Arroyo Vista Park staff played a key role in keeping the venue in top shape, and our vendors, sponsors, and partners helped elevate the event for players and fans alike.

Tournament Director Kian Kohan summed up the weekend perfectly: “We’re proud to host our 4th Playmaker Sports event and to welcome so many familiar and new teams. The energy the kids and families bring to each tournament gets us excited every time, and we can’t wait to be back here in Moorpark for the Playmakers Cup in November.”

The hot weather didn’t slow the action, though it did call for adjustments. All matches between 11 a.m. and 4 p.m. included an extra minute in each half for built-in water breaks, ensuring that players stayed safe and hydrated without losing valuable game time. Certified athletic trainers and information tents were stationed throughout the park to ensure player safety and provide clear communication for guests. Each tent was equipped with first-aid kits and ice packets in case of player injuries.

With the success of the Summer Championship, excitement is already building for the Playmakers Cup over Thanksgiving Weekend on November 29-30, which promises even more teams, thrilling games, bigger prizes, and special guests. Until then, we thank every player, parent, coach, referee, staff member, and supporter who made this year’s Summer Championship an event to remember — and we can’t wait to see the soccer community return to Moorpark in November.

title: Winter Fest 2025 Recap
snippet: A fantastic weekend of competitive matches across all age groups at Central Park in Santa Clarita.
author: Playmaker Sports
body: Winter Fest 2025 was a memorable weekend filled with competitive matches, exciting moments, and plenty of smiles. Hosted at Central Park in Santa Clarita, the tournament welcomed 90 teams across 16 brackets, with champions crowned in each division. Over 150 games were played throughout the weekend, showcasing talent from age groups 2017 to 2007.

All champions received our new Playmaker Sports trophy design, while both champions and finalists were awarded custom Playmaker Sports medals. Every participant also received a Playmaker Sports pin as a keepsake from the event.

We were thrilled to provide a variety of food and clothing vendors on-site, including breakfast burritos, chicken, chilli cheese fries, funnel cake, coffee, burgers, and hot dogs. Other vendors like Grip Socks, Game Day Braids, and LA Galaxy also attended, with LA Galaxy offering ticket specials to some champions and finalists. Custom Playmaker Sports hoodies and jerseys were available for purchase on site!

We ensured all participants had access to important resources, including information tents and certified athletic trainers stationed throughout the park for convenience and safety. Our athletic trainers were equipped with first aid medical kits and ice for tournament attendees. Free parking added to the positive experience for families and guests.

A special highlight of the event was welcoming former professional soccer player Thomas Elliott, who joined us on Championship Sunday to sign autographs and take photos with players and families. Thomas Elliott played for many professional clubs in England including Leeds United and Cambridge United. He shared some of his experiences playing against top clubs in the world such as Manchester United with players at the tournament.

We’d like to extend our gratitude to the referees and staff whose dedication ensured clear communication and smooth operations throughout the tournament. Additionally, we partnered with the Hyatt Regency Valencia to provide our traveling guests with a special discounted rate, helping make accommodations easier for teams coming from outside the area.
Congratulations to all the champions who took home the title in their respective divisions! We are excited to see everyone again at our next event, the Summer Championship, on August 2-3.
Thank you to everyone who contributed to making Winter Fest 2025 a fantastic event. We look forward to seeing you all again soon!

title: Playmakers Cup - Moorpark Recap
snippet: 116 teams competed in 195 games over two days at Arroyo Vista Park. LA Galaxy and Salvadoran soccer legend Mauricio Cienfuegos presented trophies and medals to champions and finalists.
author: Playmaker Sports
body: This past weekend, the Playmakers Cup brought the soccer community together for an incredible event filled with excitement and competition. Hosted at Arroyo Vista Park in Moorpark, CA, the tournament featured 116 teams and an impressive 195 games played over two days. Teams from boys' and girls' divisions, spanning birth years 2008 to 2018, competed in 21 groups, with 21 champions crowned by Sunday evening.

Saturday’s weather was a true test of resilience, as steady rain fell throughout most of the day. Despite the conditions, players gave it their all, showcasing passion and determination on the field. By Sunday, the rain had cleared, making way for an epic finale. A special highlight of the day was the appearance of LA Galaxy and Salvadoran soccer legend Mauricio Cienfuegos. The 7x time MLS All Star and El Salvador National Team captain joined us to present trophies and medals to the champions and finalists, as well as signing autographs and taking photos with the young athletes and older fans.

Off the field, the Playmakers Cup offered more than just soccer—it created a lively atmosphere for families and teams to enjoy. Vendors like Angel City FC, Soccer City Clothing, Grip Socks, and Gameday Braids provided unique products and services to attendees. Players had the chance to get custom braids, shop for soccer gear, and interact with soccer organizations, making the event even more memorable. As for food, the variety was unmatched—breakfast burritos, pizza, burgers, fries, funnel cakes, hot chocolate, and more kept everyone fueled throughout the weekend. There was also a camera person on site capturing the action through photos and videos, which will be featured on Playmaker Sports' social media channels in the coming days and months.

Ensuring the safety and comfort of all participants was a top priority. Certified athletic trainers were on-site, stationed across the venue, to provide immediate care if needed. Information booths staffed by our team were also available to assist with questions regarding fields or the event to keep things running smoothly.

We are excited to announce our next event on the calendar - Winter Fest. This will be held at Central Park in Santa Clarita on March 1st and 2nd, 2025. We’re looking forward to more competition, excitement, and memories created on the field! Registration is now open!
Thank you to everyone—players, families, coaches, referees, vendors, and staff—who made this event such a special weekend. See you on the field soon!

title: Playmakers Cup is Back!
snippet: We're excited to announce the return of our premier Thanksgiving weekend tournament at Arroyo Vista Park in Moorpark, CA.
author: Playmaker Sports
body: Bigger. Better. More Competitive: The Playmakers Cup is Back!

We are just over a month away from the highly anticipated second edition of the Playmakers Cup, set for November 23-24th at Arroyo Vista Park in Moorpark, CA. After the success of our first tournament, we are excited to bring you an even bigger and better event with more teams, more age groups, more fields, more vendors and more competitive soccer!

This year’s tournament will host boys' and girls' teams from age groups 2006-2017, all competing to be crowned Champions of the Playmakers Cup! Each team is guaranteed at least three games, with a fourth game for those advancing to the finals. Medals will be awarded to both winners and runners-up, with a team trophy for the champions.
Event Highlights:
• Certified Athletic Trainers will be available on-site to ensure player safety and quick response to any injuries.
• A variety of food and beverage vendors will be available to keep players and spectators energized throughout the weekend.

• Exciting vendors such as LA Galaxy, Angel City FC Street Team, Game Day Braids, and Grips Socks will be back after attending our last event, alongside new vendors offering food, clothing, and other entertainment.
Hotel Partnership for Traveling Teams:

We are pleased to offer discounted hotel rates for traveling teams through a partnership with Fairfield Inn and Suites Moorpark. To ensure your stay is both convenient and comfortable, book your accommodations using the special rate link.
Don't miss your chance to be part of this incredible event! Registration closes on November 11th, so make sure to secure your spot soon.

We are excited to build on the success of our first tournament and are committed to delivering another exceptional weekend of youth soccer. Join us at Arroyo Vista Park in Moorpark on November 23-24th for over 100 games of competitive soccer, community fun, and new champions!
We can't wait to see you there!

title: Recap of The First Ever Playmakers Cup!
snippet: The inaugural Playmakers Cup brought 62 boys' and girls' teams from across California to Central Park for more than 100 games and crowned champions across 10 divisions.
author: Playmaker Sports
body: This past February marked a significant milestone for Playmaker Sports as we hosted the first-ever Playmakers Cup at Central Park in Santa Clarita, CA. This event was for boys and girls soccer teams aged 7-14 years old. With 62 teams from all across California clashing to compete in over 100 games, the event was nothing short of spectacular.

We proudly crowned 10 champions across various age groups. These teams fought hard, showcasing exceptional skills on the field to win the tournament. Each team played 3 group games, and a final to win the cup. The clubs that lifted the first ever Playmakers Cup were Simi Valley Eclipse, Ventura Surf SC, Albion SC Central Cal, LA United, Oxnard Kickers Juventus, AYSO United Channel Islands, Dynamo SC and Newbury Park SC! Ventura Surf G2010 & B2015 are pictured with the cup and their championship medals!

Adding to the excitement of the tournament were the fantastic vendors that joined us and made the weekend more memorable. We were honored to have the LA Galaxy, Angel City FC Street Team, and Gameday Braids at the event. Their presence not only provided entertainment but also enhanced the overall experience for players and spectators alike. For player safety, the Synergy team provided certified athletic trainers who were on site around each part of the venue.

One of the highlights of the Playmakers Cup was the appearance of MLS Cup Champion and FIFA World Cup Veteran Rodney Wallace. Wallace spent the day coaching his youth club Views FC based out of Malibu, who had 5 teams attending the tournament. On Championship Sunday, Wallace signed photos and took pictures with participants, leaving many inspired and excited. Pictured is Wallace with runners up of the tournament Valley United who left with an unforgettable experience!

Food is always a crucial part of any event, and Go Fusion Grill and All American Softy ensured that our participants and attendees were well-fed with their delicious offerings. From mouth-watering fusion dishes to sweet deserts, the food vendors added a delightful taste to the tournament.

We were thrilled to partner with Hyatt Regency Valencia, providing excellent accommodation and support for our teams and their families. Their hospitality played a significant role in making the Playmakers Cup an enjoyable experience for everyone involved. The inaugural Playmakers Cup was a tremendous success, setting a high standard for future tournaments. We're excited to continue building on this foundation, creating more opportunities for youth soccer players to showcase their talents in a professional and enjoyable environment.

As we look ahead to more events, we want to extend a heartfelt thank you to all the teams, vendors, partners, and fans who made this event unforgettable. Stay tuned for more announcements about upcoming tournaments and events from Playmaker Sports.
